_comment: Hand-written copy for the project cards. Every number shown on the cards is fetched live; only these texts are static. Facts are taken from each project's own README.

featured.tagline: Persona 3 Portable, running natively on the New Nintendo 3DS.
facts: The whole PSP executable is statically recompiled into 237 C++ units
Playable early: 28–30 fps in the field, 16–25 fps in battle, saves work
Known issues are tracked in the open. No game data ships in the repo

featured.tagline: One app, every protocol. A GUI launcher for VPN and proxy engines.
facts: Drives sing-box, Xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG and OpenVPN from one UI
Imports links, subscriptions, .conf / .ovpn files and QR codes
Built-in Zapret and tg-ws-proxy, encrypted secrets, TUN mode

more.desc: A local anime library: parallel multi-source search, voiceover choice and offline downloads. No account, no cloud.

more.name: Enderlit Player
more.desc: A minimal desktop player for local music libraries. 2.0 is a full rewrite with a dark-first UI and tests.
Drag files in, press send: a tiny frontend for FBI Remote Install that pushes .cia / .3dsx to a 3DS over LAN.

_language_highlight: Languages that always get their own row in the language chart, with their real share of bytes, when they exist in the data. Never adds a language that is not there.
_exclude_repos: Repositories whose commits carry my name/e-mail without being mine (e.g. bots that push empty commits with forged authorship). They are never read for commits or languages.
